description: This file defines the ReturnStatus class, which manages CRUD operations related to return status entries within the OpenCart e-commerce system. It includes methods for adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving return status data and descriptions, reflecting its role in localisation settings.

classes.name: ReturnStatus
classes.description: A model class in the Opencart system responsible for managing return status records including creation, update, deletion, and retrieval, along with handling multilingual descriptions.

methods.name: addReturnStatus
methods.description: Creates a new return status entry for each language provided in the input data, inserts descriptions, clears cache, and returns the new return status ID.

methods.name: editReturnStatus
methods.description: Updates an existing return status; deletes its current descriptions, adds new descriptions, and clears the cache.

methods.name: deleteReturnStatus
methods.description: Deletes a return status entry by ID and clears related cache.

methods.name: deleteReturnStatusesByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all return status descriptions associated with a specific language ID and clears cache.

methods.name: getReturnStatus
methods.description: Retrieves a specific return status record based on its ID and the current language setting.

methods.name: getReturnStatuses
methods.description: Fetches a list of return statuses, optionally sorted and paginated, for the current language.

methods.name: getTotalReturnStatuses
methods.description: Returns the total count of return statuses for the current language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Obtains all descriptions of a return status across all languages.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Fetches all return status descriptions for a specific language.
